reviewer.tool: OpenAI Codex gpt-5.6-terra xhigh fresh independent read-only precode and exact source review of Gateway IPv6 canonicalization, unchanged rejection predicates and public contracts, bounded spelling-equivalence and consumer denial regressions, source-only proof limits, exact documentation/registry/inventory diff and named validation, followed by actual source and three-file direct-child bindings

findings.summary: The supplied sampled review identified alternate IPv6 spellings bypassing the existing public HTTPS target rejection predicates. Independent static/source review and focused regression evidence confirm the bounded validator defect and repair: locally canonicalize valid IPv6 literals before the unchanged deny policy, fail closed on unsupported scoped literals, preserve IPv4 and mapped-address rejection, and stop blocked A2A/Registry targets before their verifiers. The original classifier fails 21 assertions; the repaired focused set passes 76 tests. A live network-fetch path, P1 impact, runtime activation and broader security assurance remain unproven.
